'''Nightmare Squadron''' was a unit of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-wing starfighters]] deployed to [[Titan Base]], a subterranean [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] facility in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the squadron was conducting operations mainly in nearby sectors and had developed a reputation for lightning-fast, destructive raids on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] targets. At the time of the arrival of an [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] team for a [[Operation: Shell Game|mission]] to disrupt the Empire's [[Project Shell-cracker|Operation: Shell-cracker]], the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was preparing for what its commander [[Jayce Terril]] called an ambush double, where they can execute a micro-jump to another location. Shortly afterward, the squadron [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspaced]] to [[HM7-R|the Hammer]] to assist the team in stealing the [[Shell-cracker prototype]] and battled [[Alpha Squadron (The Hammer)|Alpha Squadron]].

==Behind the scenes==
Nightmare Squadron appears in "[[Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|Operation: Shell Game]]," the adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]].
